description: Propose up to three fair meeting times while the slot is still being chosen. Ranking does not take a meeting length. A city's public holiday down-ranks that slot and is named in the reasons. Each slot city says whether that date is a holiday. Each slot has a score and the reasons. The result has one https://timeofmeeting.com link that opens the planner with those cities, and next_step, which says the user can choose a duration when creating the invitation. It does not include calendar files or a QR code. After a slot is chosen, call create_meeting_link.

cities.description: Two to eight cities. An array, or one comma-separated string. City name or a city id from search_cities. Spelling and accents are flexible. When several cities share a name, the best match from the site search is used and the others come back in alternatives.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to six days after the start. At most 31 days.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: find_best_meeting_time

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

weeks.description: ISO week (Monday start; week 1 contains the year's first Thursday) and US week (Sunday start; 1 January is week 1 of that calendar year).

title: Find a fair meeting time
